target_customer: Mass market restaurants in Latin America that take orders by phone, cash and WhatsApp
problem: Most small restaurants in Latin America take orders by phone and settle in cash, and they lose margin to marketplaces that charge commissions.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for restaurants (digital menu, WhatsApp ordering, POS, CRM) with commission free orders

founders.name: Carol Riboud
previous_startups: Busportal.pe (sold to redbus, a Naspers company)
founders.background_notes: YC page: French, based mostly in Latin America.

founders.name: Ulysse Lichtle
founders.background_notes: YC page: French, in Peru since 2012, worked in five countries mainly in transportation and tourism.

founders.name: Jose Rico
founders.background_notes: YC page: 15 plus years in strategy and operations consulting. TechCrunch (May 2022) says he co-founded OlaClick in 2020 with three other entrepreneurs.

technical_complexity.rationale: Digital menus, WhatsApp order flow and a POS are standard web and messaging integrations. Scale across 20 plus countries added localization work.

defensibility.rationale: Many local tools offered menus and WhatsApp orders. Switching costs rise once the POS and CRM hold a restaurant's data, and the company later cited 40,000 plus restaurants.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Marketplaces were integration partners rather than copycats. Delivery Hero and Meta became investors in 2022. The company site (2026) lists iFood, 99Food, Rappi and Keeta as integrations.

market_need_then: TechCrunch (2022) reports more than 80 percent of food delivery orders in Latin America were still made by phone and paid in cash, and the company positioned commission free WhatsApp ordering against marketplace fees.

branding.domain_note: Uses olaclick.com; no acquisition story found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, direct and practical, with short slogans such as 'Technology that pays for itself' (company Brazil site, 2026).

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself was found. The name echoes Ola (the Indian ride hailing brand) in search results, but ola means hello in Spanish and Portuguese, which fits the market; no source states this as intent.

outcome_analysis: OlaClick grew from a Winter 2021 YC company to a restaurant platform reporting 45,000 plus restaurants and over 1 million orders a month by May 2022, with a seed round led by Gradient Ventures and backing from Meta and Delivery Hero. It remains active and now sells a POS, chatbot and invoicing suite in Brazil and beyond. Its edge was commission free WhatsApp ordering for restaurants ignored by marketplaces. No later round, acquisition or layoff was found.
notes: Round confirmed by TechCrunch and the law firm Gunderson Dettmer client news (4.4M). A Delivery Hero Ventures headline states 4.6M for the round and aggregators give 4.53M or 6.4M total raised, so totals conflict and funding is partial. The dhventures page returned 403. Aggregator entries dated 2018 or 2021 were not recorded as rounds. Founders count differs: YC lists three, TechCrunch says four co-founders. Competitor search returned only 2022 or later sources (Fudo, Brendi, Plick, Entu) with no dated near the batch, so the list is empty. Outcome search found nothing on layoffs, shutdown or acquisition.
